# Manual Ricebox workload profile matrix

This is an umbrella across separate opt-in passes, not a collection of timings from a single CI job. The proposed exact-C++ CI is a **first sublane only**. None of the profiles below are marked measured by this matrix. In particular a C++ result cannot set the browser, producer, terminal, Everyday, C or representative-project lanes green.

| Group and lane IDs | Genuine scenarios and minimum receipt | Runner / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| producer: build_clean, build_warm, aot_miss, aot_hit, pack_deploy | Exact source pins and reproducible ELF/root/pack digests; empty normal build vs retained inputs; explicitly prove AOT lookup MISS executes original ELF→Wasm conversion vs exact-key HIT reads verified same output; changed pin invalidates; overlap producer compile/hash/package work; pack/chunk bytes, order and lifetime. Keep release-prod publish out of diagnostics; stage an authorized disposable fixture only. | Official isolated Linux builder with correct base metadata; producer start→verified emitted artifact, distinct from service readiness and user execution. |
| demo_browser: initial_navigation, return_navigation, isolated_worker | Actual /demo/ in normal isolated Chrome (no flags weakening sandbox); fresh profile with empty relevant caches vs independent second normal fresh-tab navigation to the same URL in the same browser process/profile with ordinary cache/Service Worker state (not reload, BFCache or cache-buster), and explicit offline/miss/failure controls. Measure real shell ready/echo; request digest, connection/TTFB, range/cache bytes, parse/instantiate/Worker/VFS stages, exact anchor to visible ready. Verify expected COI/Worker mode and separately run inline if wanted; Node smoke is not browser proof. | Signed/canonical fixture+reachable isolated test server, native browser, supported network shaping; no prod deploy, fake prompt, or prebuilt-page substitution. |
| installed_terminal: shell_cli, process_wait, filesystem, ipc | Real installed CLI→terminal→shell and complete outputs/status; one builtin, external command, pipeline, interrupts/PTY, fork/exec/wait; stat/read/write/open/rename over representative large/small hot/cold files, pipe/socket/backpressure and FD/namespace semantics. Time handoff, terminal echo, output, parent wait separately. | Real installed native terminal and corresponding Ricebox lane on same certified machine where comparable, real normal security, exact root/toolchain; separate browser Worker coverage. |
| toolchain: c_matrix, cpp_matrix, representative_projects, cpp_deep | Per language C and C++: clean, direct-source dirty, shared-header fanout, link-only and no-op; parallelism stated, true artifacts/dep/log/exit verified or explicit no-op proof. Add representative real project(s), failure/recovery, toolchain sizes. cpp_deep requires passing the separately scoped exact-C++ profile, not just generic run/fixture evidence. | Same immutable root/ELF/views/ABI on same x86-64 native/Sods runner. Serial causal passes and representative parallel builds separate. |
| everyday: input_to_frame, frame_pacing, focus_resize_ime | Actual supported Everyday/Wayland workload: verify key/pointer/scroll/resize, canvas operation, focus and IME end-to-end. Correlate hardware or input injection through guest delivery/compositor present to actual observed frame; main vs Worker vs GPU, dropped frames/jank/DPR. No screenshot-only or synthetic UI bypass treated as an app run. | Normal browser/desktop with graphics and trace adapter; real frame timestamps, installed transport/backend identified. |
| crosscut: identity_parity, timing_and_tail, cpu_and_instructions, runtime_io_wait, memory_and_faults | Every applicable executed scenario needs scoped identity/correctness, separate uninstrumented timing with repeats and valid tail confidence, main/background CPU/JIT, real guest/host instruction denominators where feasible, runtime/I/O/blocking and per-owner highwater plus host faults. Record explicit approved applicability/config, unknown and observer perturbation; no extrapolation or cross-run subtraction. | Event/counter availability is checked at actual runner without policy changes; unavailable not zero; distinct cold/warm, profiler and acceptance runs. |

Gate input: JSON `{"groups":{"toolchain":{"cpp_deep":"partial"}}}`; `python3 -B ricebox_coverage.py REPORT.json`. Omitted lanes are not_run, partial/unavailable/not_run/fail keep the umbrella incomplete (exit 2). Only enums are emitted, with no raw artifacts or metrics. Collectors must independently verify receipts before asserting any pass, including checking that crosscut evidence covers the entire applicable matrix rather than borrowing C++ status. No Work/profile/browser setting or network/sandbox relaxation is part of this proposal.
